name: Shenzhou 12
payload: Three astronauts: Nie Haisheng (commander), Liu Boming and Tang Hongbo
first: The first crew to enter China's Tiangong space station, through its Tianhe core module
description: Nie Haisheng, Liu Boming and Tang Hongbo were the first crew to enter China's Tiangong space station, through its Tianhe core module, launched on 2021-04-29. A Long March 2F lifted off from the Jiuquan Satellite Launch Center on 2021-06-17 at 01:22 UTC (9:22 Beijing time). About 6.5 hours later, at 07:54 UTC, Shenzhou 12 docked at the front port of Tianhe after a fast automated rendezvous, and the crew entered the module at 10:48 UTC. They made two spacewalks, on 2021-07-04 (Liu Boming and Tang Hongbo, with commander Nie Haisheng inside) and on 2021-08-20 (Nie Haisheng and Liu Boming), more than 12 hours in all. Shenzhou 12 undocked at 00:56 UTC on 2021-09-16, flew a radial rendezvous test, and landed at the Dongfeng site at 05:34 UTC on 2021-09-17, after 92 days in orbit, China's longest crewed mission to that date.

events.label: LAUNCH
events.note: Long March 2F from the Jiuquan Satellite Launch Center, 2021-06-17, 01:22 UTC (9:22 Beijing time).

events.label: DOCKING
events.note: Docks at the front port of Tianhe at 07:54 UTC, 6.5 hours after launch, after a fast automated rendezvous.

events.label: HATCH OPEN
events.note: The crew enters the Tianhe core module at 10:48 UTC (18:48 Beijing time) after sealing, leak and pressure checks.

events.label: FIRST SPACEWALK
events.note: 2021-07-04: Liu Boming and Tang Hongbo go outside, Liu first, at 00:11 UTC (8:11 Beijing time); Nie Haisheng stays inside. They install foot stops on the robotic arm and a working station, and raise the panoramic camera.

events.label: SECOND SPACEWALK
events.note: 2021-08-20: Nie Haisheng and Liu Boming work outside for about six hours and return at 06:33 UTC (14:33 Beijing time), having installed and adjusted equipment, shown their suits and tested the large robotic arm.

events.label: UNDOCKING
events.note: Undocks at 00:56 UTC on 2021-09-16 and flies a radial rendezvous test, from in front of the station to a point below it.

events.label: LANDING
events.note: Lands at the Dongfeng site at 05:34 UTC on 2021-09-17 (13:34 Beijing time), after 92 days in orbit.
